blr._note: Anchor = geographic point mapped to the scene origin. rotDeg (applied after equirectangular projection, x'=x cos-z sin, z'=x sin+z cos) is the bearing fit of Doctor B R Ambedkar Veedhi (-46.94 deg in raw east/north-up frame) so it runs along +x. Anchor was solved so the road centre line sits on z=0 and the real Vidhana Soudha relation bbox centre sits at x=48. The real building is ~158 m behind the road (hand-made one is at z=-100), so the real centroid lands near (48,-158); the hand-made group replaces it.
